'''Heal''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to help the healing process in another individual as long as they were in physical contact. Ascendants were required to know the [[lessen another's pain]] spell to use the heal spell.
